photos.caption: The high ledge (old attic floor) and attic window, from the lounge

current.summary: Now part of the lounge: with the ceiling removed, the attic volume is open to the room below. What remains of the old attic floor is the high white ledge over the niche on the angled side, with the small attic window. Decide what it becomes — a reachable display/storage shelf, a small reading loft with a ladder, or simply open volume.
issues: Headroom under the pitch to be measured
Roof insulation and condensation to check before any use is decided
